description: Wait until part of the screen changes or settles, instead of guessing a sleep. Returns the elapsed time, changed regions (screenshot pixels; add `origin` for desktop), and the final state.

exactTitle.description: window: targets match the whole title only (default false).

keep.description: Keep the final screenshot on disk and return its path (default false).

mode.description: change (default): return once it differs from the start. settle: once it has been still for settleSec.

pixelThreshold.description: Mean 0-255 difference for a ~32x32 cell to count as changed (default 12).

returnImage.description: Return the final state inline (default true).

target.description: What to watch: full | monitor:<i> | window:<title> (or exe=/hwnd=) | region:<x>,<y>,<w>,<h>.

timeoutSec.description: Give up after this many seconds (default 30; a timeout is a result, not an error).

name: wait_for_change
title: Wait for Screen Change
